select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ d.PS as psCode,/**交易方向Code**/ d.PS as ps,/**交易方向**/ d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarketCode,/**交易场所Code**/ d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ '' as 清算速度,/**清算速度**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate,/**交易日**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate,/**交割日**/ d.INV_AIM as invAimCode,/**投资目的Code**/ d.INV_AIM as invAim,/**投资目的**/ '' as 结算方式,/**结算方式**/ IFNULL(CASE d.TRADER WHEN 'null' THEN null ELSE d.TRADER END,'') as trader,/**交易员**/
d.is_out_trade as isOutTradeCode,/* 是否外部交易Code */ d.is_out_trade as isOutTrade,/* 是否外部交易 */ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
'' as 对手方交易员,/**对手方交易员**/
sma.SEC_ACCT_NAME as secManageAcctId,/** 债券管理户 **/ d.CHL_ID as chlId,/** 通道 **/ d.CCY as ccyCode,/**交易币种Code**/ d.CCY as ccy,/**交易币种**/ IFNULL(d.PAR_VALUE,0)*IFNULL(d.PRIN_AMT,0) as prinAmt,/**券面总额/交易本金**/ d.share_Amt*100 as shareAmt, /**交易份额**/ d.UNIT_CPRICE as unitCprice, /**单位净价**/ d.UNIT_INT as unitInt,/**单位利息**/ d.UNIT_FPRICE as unitFprice, /**单位全价**/ d.CPRICE_AMT as cpriceAmt, /**净价总额**/ d.INT_AMT as intAmt, /**应收利息总额 - 取利息总额**/ d.FPRICE_AMT as fpriceAmt, /**全价总额**/ d.FEE_AMT_PAY as feeAmtPay,/**随交易应计费用**/ d.FEE_AMT_UNPAY as feeAmtUnpay,/**不随交易应计费用**/ d.FEE_AMT as feeAmt, /**总交易费用**/ tdf.FEE_AMT as tdFeeAmt,/**通道费**/
d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ (d.YIELD) * 100 as yield, /**到期收益率**/ (d.EXER_YIELD) * 100 as exerYield, /**行权收益率**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, /**交易状态Code**/ d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, /**交易状态**/
DATE_FORMAT(d.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as vdate,/** 计息开始日 **/ DATE_FORMAT(d.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as mdate,/** 计息截止日 **/ d.PAR_VALUE as parValue,/** 当期单位面值 **/ d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt/** 交易本金 - 应收本金 **/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09'
left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO sma on sma.SEC_ACCT_ID = d.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
